inlines.v: RUST'IC, RUST'ICAL, adjective [Latin rusticus, from rus, the country.] 1. Pertaining to the country; rural; as the rustic gods of antiquity. 2. Rude; unpolished; rough; awkward; as rustic manners or behavior. 3. Coarse; plain; simple; as rustic entertainment; rustic dress. 4. Simple; artless; unadorned. Rustic work, in a building, is when the stones, etc., in the face of it, are hacked or pecked so as to be rough. RUST'IC, noun An inhabitant of the country; a clown.
